average_models: average parameters across multiple PyTorch models and save the result into a target model
clone_model: deep copy a PyTorch model with optional dtype conversion to float32 or float64
clip_gradients: clip model gradients by a maximum normalized L2 norm value
get_mismatched_param: compare parameters across multiple models and return the name of the first mismatched parameter
linear_comb_models: compute a weighted linear combination of two models and save the result into a third model
